Breath of Life - The Lathspell





Breath of Life: The Lathspell is our third product in the Breath of Life product line. It is a reimagining of a curse-weilding warrior class from the 3.5 edition of a very popular table-top roleplaying system. Like the Vanguard and Spelljack, it is not a copy-paste update. No, this is a whole new class with new mechanics and systems to make it dynamic and fun to use along side other classes available in Pathfinder 1st edition.

In this book you will get the following:

<ul> <li> A full 1-20 level class leveraging the curse infusing their bodies into their martial combat.</li>
<li> 7 Curses that determine the growth and progression of the lathspell</li>
<li> 3 archetypes to tailor your lathspell to your playstyle, like the ranged black arrow or pious martyred soul.</li>
<li> 4 archetypes to bring cursed themes and mechanics and abilities to other classes like the curse weaver magus, or foehunter inquisitor.</li>
<li> New spells to crush your foes.</li>
<li> Feats to further enhance your skills.</li>
<li> Magic items to leverage your abilities.</li>
<li> An example NPC with levels in the class you can use as a guide or as an NPC to interact with your players. </li>
</ul> These options are guaranteed to bring some dark and mystic combat to your table-top battlefield.











"
